_why: AuroraCurtain's bands are altitude spans (numbers that may not overlap) with colours, and its ruler draws only the film's own ticks; the structure is fixed here (the sourced emission key: pink 80-100, green 100-200, red 200-320 km, ticks 100/200/300) so the sweep measures the RULED layout, and only the copy paths get the fixture's words.
